questions.question: The administrative auditor reported that it was ______ for the department to verify physical assets before releasing funds.
questions.explanation: Sentence structure: 'it was [adjective] for the department to verify...' demands an ADJECTIVE. 'Prudent' (Option B) is the correct grammatical form. Option A is a noun, Option C is an adverb, and Option D is a negative noun.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Same Part-of-Speech Concord Law

questions.question: Choose the most accurate ANTONYM of 'DISINTERESTED' as used in judicial arbitration:
questions.explanation: 'Disinterested' ka arth nishpaksh ya impartial hota hai. Iska opposite pakshpaati ya 'Prejudiced' (Option B) ya 'Biased' hoga. Option A ('Uninterested') ruchi na lene ka distractor trap hai. Option C ('Equitable') iska synonym hai.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-09: Negative Prefix False Friends Neutralizer

questions.question: What is the true ANTONYM of 'INVALUABLE' in competitive English?
questions.explanation: 'Invaluable' ka arth anmol ya bohot keemti hota hai. Iska opposite bina kisi keemat ka yani 'Valueless' (Option B) ya 'Worthless' hoga. Options A, C, aur D iske synonyms hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-09: Negative Prefix False Friends Neutralizer

questions.question: Which of the following words is a SYNONYM of 'INFLAMMABLE'?
questions.explanation: 'INFLAMMABLE' ka matlab aag pakadne wala hota hai (flammable/combustible). Option A ('Combustible') iska true synonym hai. Options B aur C iske antonyms hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-09: Negative Prefix False Friends Neutralizer

questions.question: In the phrase "measures to MITIGATE economic hardship", the word 'MITIGATE' is closest in meaning to:
questions.explanation: 'MITIGATE' (Verb) ka arth kast ya gambhirta ko kam karna (alleviate, assuage) hota hai. Option A ('Alleviate') sahi synonym hai. Options B aur D iske antonyms hain.

questions.question: What is the exact ANTONYM of the adjective 'TACITURN'?
questions.explanation: 'TACITURN' ka matlab kam bolne wala hota hai. Iska opposite bohot zyada bolne wala yani 'Garrulous' ya 'Loquacious' (Option B) hota hai. Options A, C, aur D iske synonyms hain.

questions.question: Choose the most appropriate SYNONYM of the noun 'CANDOR':
questions.explanation: 'CANDOR' ek Noun hai jiska arth khulapan aur imaandari (frankness, forthrightness) hota hai. Option B ('Forthrightness') Noun form mein exact synonym hai. Option C Adverb hai; Options A aur D antonyms hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-01: Same Part-of-Speech Concord Law

questions.question: In judicial proceedings, what is the polar opposite (ANTONYM) of 'EXONERATE'?
questions.explanation: 'EXONERATE' ka matlab ilzaam se mukt karna hota hai. Iska opposite kisi ko jurm mein phansana ya aaropi thehrana yani 'Incriminate' (Option C) hota hai. Options A, B, aur D synonyms hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-04: Binary Complementary Opposition Law

questions.question: Choose the closest SYNONYM for 'PERNICIOUS':
questions.explanation: 'PERNICIOUS' ka arth ghatak aur vinashkari (deleterious, harmful) hota hai. Option A ('Deleterious') iska synonym hai. Options B, C, aur D iske positive antonyms hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-07: Tone & Connotation Polarity Concord

questions.question: Which prefix correctly forms the standard negative antonym of 'RESPONSIBLE'?
questions.explanation: Rule RC-08 ke mutabiq, initial 'R' ke aage Latin prefix 'in-' assimilate hokar 'ir-' ban jata hai (ir- + responsible = Irresponsible). Option B is standard.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-08: Phonetic Prefix Assimilation Rules

questions.question: What is the precise paired ANTONYM of 'ZENITH'?
questions.explanation: 'ZENITH' ka arth sarvochch shikhar hota hai. Iska opposite sabse nichla bindu yani 'Nadir' (Option B) hota hai. Options A, C, aur D iske synonyms hain.

questions.question: Choose the most accurate SYNONYM of 'UBIQUITOUS':
questions.explanation: 'UBIQUITOUS' ka arth har jagah paaya jaane wala hota hai. Option A ('Omnipresent') iska exact synonym hai. Options B, C, aur D iske antonyms hain.

questions.question: Identify the word that is an accurate SYNONYM of 'VACILLATE':
questions.explanation: 'VACILLATE' (Verb) ka arth faisla lene mein hichkichana ya dulamul hona hota hai. Option A ('Waver') iska synonym hai. Option B iska antonym hai aur Option C ek unrelated lookalike verb hai.

questions.question: What is the classic competitive examination ANTONYM of 'QUIXOTIC'?
questions.explanation: 'QUIXOTIC' ka arth a-vyavaharik aur kalpanik aadarshvadi hota hai. Iska opposite vyavaharik aur real-world approach wala yani 'Pragmatic' (Option B) hota hai. Options A, C, aur D iske synonyms hain.

questions.question: In the analysis of disputed affidavits, what is the polar ANTONYM of 'GENUINE'?
questions.explanation: 'GENUINE' ka arth asli aur pramanik hota hai. Nakli, banavati ya farzi dastavez ke liye 'Spurious' (Option B) ya 'Counterfeit' iska exact polar antonym hai. Options A, C, aur D iske synonyms hain.
questions.ruleReference: Rule RC-11: Collocational Compatibility & Register Law
